description: Información geográfica de sistemas y servicios de saneamiento is a dataset listed in Uruguayan national open data catalogue (catalogodatos.gub.uy), an open data portal, published or maintained by OSE. Este conjunto reúne diversas capas geográficas que representan información territorial relacionada con la infraestructura y los servicios saneamiento de OSE. Incluye redes, coberturas poblacionales y otras capas temáticas relevantes para la planificación, operación y análisis geoespacial. Coverage: Uruguay. The portal files it under the publisher OSE. Its tags are GIS, Harvest, Saneamiento. It offers 15 resource(s) in CSV, KMZ, SHP. The portal shows 2026-08-20 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licencia de DAG de Uruguay. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-uy-portal.
